about.title: About the School District of Philadelphia
about.content: The School District of Philadelphia, also known as SDP, serves public school families across Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. The academic calendar is the main districtwide planning source for student attendance days, staff professional development, term dates, holidays, and major school-year milestones.

about.title: How to Use This SDP Calendar
about.content: Use this page for School District of Philadelphia calendar planning, including first day dates, kindergarten interview days, school closures, report card conferences, professional development days, Winter Recess, Spring Recess, testing windows, graduation windows, and the last day of school. Families should verify school-specific events, athletics, testing details, ceremonies, and program calendars directly with SDP.

planningTips.title: Planning Tips for Philadelphia Families
content: SDP may list different first-day details for grades 1-12 and kindergarten, so kindergarten families should check the interview-day schedule carefully.
Report card conference days can close schools for students or create early dismissal schedules depending on the school year.
The district calendar includes Keystone and PSSA testing windows for planning, but school-level testing details should be confirmed with individual schools.
Some religious holidays begin at sundown the evening before the listed date, and SDP asks families and staff to be mindful when scheduling tests, activities, and events.

customSections.label: About SDP Calendar Structure
customSections.content: The School District of Philadelphia academic calendar separates student attendance days from staff professional development and reorganization days, school closures, report card conferences, early dismissal days when applicable, term dates, interim report due dates, testing windows, graduation windows, and cultural or religious observances. Kindergarten may follow a different first-week schedule because of interview days.

customSections.label: SDP District Calendar vs School-Specific Calendars
customSections.content: The SDP academic calendar is the districtwide source for first day, last day, holidays, recesses, professional development, report card conferences, and testing windows. It does not replace school-specific calendars for campus events, bell schedules, athletics, testing assignments, graduation ceremonies, and program-specific dates.

customSections.label: How We Collect SDP Calendar Data
customSections.content: MySchoolDates reviews the official School District of Philadelphia calendar page and academic calendar PDFs, then extracts first day, last day, school closures, professional development dates, report card conference dates, recess windows, testing windows, graduation windows, term dates, and calendar notes. The page links back to SDP so families can verify updates before making final childcare, travel, transportation, or work plans.

groups.label: How We Verify SDP Calendar Dates
items: Locate the official School District of Philadelphia calendar source and current academic calendar PDF.
Compare PDF dates with district calendar page information when both are available.

Update MySchoolDates when SDP publishes revised calendar information or families report a possible error.

customSections.label: SDP Calendar Update Policy
customSections.content: School calendars may change after publication because of district decisions, weather closures, administrative updates, emergency closures, or revised school-year guidance. MySchoolDates reviews official SDP calendar sources and updates this page when revised information becomes available. Always confirm urgent schedule changes with the School District of Philadelphia and your individual school before making critical childcare, transportation, travel, or work plans.

districtFaqs.q: Which School District of Philadelphia calendar does this page summarize?
districtFaqs.a: This page summarizes the official SDP academic calendars for the listed school years.

districtFaqs.q: Does kindergarten start on the same day in SDP?
districtFaqs.a: Not always. The 2026-2027 SDP calendar lists August 24, 2026 as the first day for grades 1-12 and August 27, 2026 as the first day for kindergarten, after kindergarten interview days.

districtFaqs.q: What are SDP report card conference days?
districtFaqs.a: Report card conference days are calendar dates set aside for family conferences and reporting. Depending on the school year, they may be full no-school days for students or half-day early dismissals.

districtFaqs.q: Does the SDP calendar include testing windows?
districtFaqs.a: Yes. The academic calendar notes districtwide Keystone and PSSA testing windows for planning purposes. Families should confirm school-specific testing schedules with their school.

districtFaqs.q: Does SDP have school on Friday after Thanksgiving?
districtFaqs.a: No. The 2026-2027 SDP calendar lists Thanksgiving Recess on Thursday, November 26 and Friday, November 27, 2026, with schools closed.

districtFaqs.q: Does SDP have school on Election Day?
districtFaqs.a: No. The SDP 2026-2027 calendar lists Election Day on Tuesday, November 3, 2026 as a school closure day.

districtFaqs.q: How many days is SDP Winter Break?
districtFaqs.a: SDP Winter Recess runs from Wednesday, December 23, 2026 through Friday, January 1, 2027, including 8 weekdays without school.

districtFaqs.q: Is the SDP calendar the same for all schools?
districtFaqs.a: The district academic calendar provides districtwide dates for School District of Philadelphia schools, but individual schools may publish additional events, bell schedules, testing details, ceremonies, or program calendars.

districtFaqs.q: Does the SDP calendar include teacher work days?
districtFaqs.a: Yes. The SDP calendar includes staff professional development and reorganization dates that may be school closure days for students.

districtFaqs.q: Where should families verify SDP calendar updates?
districtFaqs.a: Use the official School District of Philadelphia calendar page and school announcements for final confirmation. MySchoolDates is an independent reference and is not affiliated with the School District of Philadelphia.
